Third-party notices
===================

libwing 1.0.6 (revision 36d713e), by Danny Firesnake
https://github.com/dannyfiresnake/libwing

WING Access includes a modified version of libwing and an adapted offline catalog.
Its license is included in libwing-LICENSE.txt and licenses/libwing/.

Modification notice:
- src/ffi.rs and libwing.h: additional application interface functions and
  corrected declarations.
- src/console.rs: connection handling, parameter encoding, validation and
  meter reception changes, including consecutive escape-byte decoding.
- src/node.rs: checked decoding of received parameter definitions; malformed
  records return an error instead of panicking across the application interface.
  Live definitions emit explicit true/false read-only flags.
- Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock: dependency changes and a reference to the supplied
  LICENSE file in the package metadata.
- README.md and REFERENCE-DATA.txt: notes on the included reference data.

License and copyright notices for dependencies are included in
licenses/<crate-version>/. Rust runtime notices are in licenses/rust-runtime/.
These components retain their respective license terms and rights.

Behringer WING initial settings and DAW control presets
https://www.behringer.com/en/wing

The offline initial settings and eight DAW control presets originate from WING
firmware 3.1.2 and WING Edit 3.3.4. Preset values are unchanged; an empty audio-data
section was added to the partial DAW snapshots for file-format compatibility.
These materials and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners.
